note: Tag keys a cellar or vineyard record may carry. Each tag names a source. Ownership and welcome tags are never inferred from a name, a photograph or a hunch. A certification tag names the certifier. Tier cited = a named page; harvested = a public register or dataset fetched by a tool; field = someone stood there.

entries.label: Tasting room
entries.evidence: the cellar's own visit page, a published appellation visitor list, or an OpenStreetMap node tagged craft=winery with opening hours

entries.label: By appointment
entries.evidence: the cellar's own words on its visit page

entries.label: No visitors
entries.evidence: the cellar says so, or a published list records it as closed to the public

entries.label: Estate fruit
entries.evidence: the cellar's own statement, or a label term with a legal definition behind it (US: estate bottled, 27 CFR 4.26)

entries.label: Certified organic
entries.evidence: a named certifier and, where published, a certificate number: CCOF, Oregon Tilth, USDA Organic, Ecocert, Agriculture Biologique, BioGro

entries.label: Sustainability certified
entries.evidence: a named scheme: LIVE, Salmon-Safe, SIP, Napa Green, Sustainable Winegrowing NZ, Certified California Sustainable

entries.label: Dry-farmed
entries.evidence: the grower's own statement or a press profile that reports it as practice, not aspiration

entries.label: Own-rooted
entries.evidence: the grower or a published vineyard survey saying the vines are ungrafted

entries.label: Monopole
entries.evidence: one owner holds the whole named site; the appellation body or the owner says so

entries.label: Family-held
entries.evidence: the cellar's own account naming the family and the generation, or a press profile

entries.label: Woman winemaker
entries.evidence: the cellar names her in the role, or a press profile does

entries.label: Woman-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, or a women-owned business certification

entries.label: Black-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, or a published directory of Black-owned wineries

entries.label: Latino-owned
entries.evidence: the owner's own statement, a press profile naming the owner, or a published directory

entries.label: LGBTQ+ owned
entries.evidence: the business's own statement, a directory or press list whose framing says the businesses in it are LGBTQ-owned; never inferred

entries.label: Closed
entries.evidence: a dated notice, a news report, or the cellar's own announcement
